_: What CI expects of this example (read by .github/workflows/ci.yml + scripts/api-smoke.mjs). Update it together with any change to the example — this file is a declaration; CI does not infer it from the code, because inference would misread «things got deleted» as «they never existed» and silently pass. sdkMethods is an add-only ratchet: never delete an entry — when the example genuinely stops calling a method, keep it listed and record it in the optional removedSdkMethods as {"method": "non-empty reason"}; CI prints the reason as an audit trail. Updating the baseline by copying an error message is exactly the bypass this guards against.
